The objective of this document is to outline a series of team-building activities aimed at enhancing team cohesion, communication, and overall productivity. The activities are designed to be inclusive, engaging, and beneficial for all team members.

Activity 1: Problem-Solving Workshop
  - Description: A workshop where teams are presented with several problem scenarios related to their work. Teams will brainstorm and present their solutions.
  - Objective: To improve problem-solving skills and encourage innovative thinking.
  - Location: Conference room A
  - Date: 2023-11-15
  - Time: 10:00 - 12:00

Activity 2: Outdoor Team Challenge
  - Description: Teams compete in a series of outdoor challenges that require teamwork, physical effort, and strategic thinking.
  - Objective: To strengthen team bonds and encourage physical wellness.
  - Location: Green Park
  - Date: 2023-11-22
  - Time: 09:00 - 15:00

Hawaii Packing List
Emma Johnson's Vacation - June 10th to June 20th, 2024

Based on the itinerary from vacation-plans.docx

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES
  - Swimwear (2-3 pieces)
  - Sunscreen (reef-safe, SPF 50+)
  - Beach towel
  - Flip-flops / sandals
  - Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
  - Water shoes (for kayaking at Kailua Beach)
  - Dry bag / waterproof phone case
  - Rash guard

HIKING & OUTDOOR GEAR
  - Hiking boots / sturdy sneakers
  - Hiking shorts / pants
  - Moisture-wicking shirts
  - Hat with brim
  - Sunglasses
  - Reusable water bottle
  - Small backpack / daypack
  - Insect repellent

CASUAL & EVENING WEAR
  - Casual outfits (shorts, t-shirts, tank tops)
  - Light dress / nice outfit for Luau
  - Light jacket or sweater (for evenings)
  - Comfortable walking shoes (for Pearl Harbor & shopping)
  - Pajamas / loungewear

SPA & RELAXATION
  - Comfortable spa attire
  - Flip-flops for the spa

ACCESSORIES & ELECTRONICS
  - Camera (for capturing memories)
  - Phone charger / power bank
  - Waterproof phone case
  - Headphones / earbuds

TOILETRIES
  - Sunscreen (extra supply)
  - Lip balm with SPF
  - Aloe vera / after-sun lotion
  - Shampoo, conditioner, body wash
  - Deodorant
  - Toothbrush, toothpaste, floss
  - Hairbrush / hair ties

HEALTH & MEDICAL
  - Motion sickness pills (for road trip)
  - Basic first-aid kit (band-aids, antiseptic)
  - Pain relievers
  - Any personal medications

TRAVEL DOCUMENTS
  - Flight tickets / boarding passes
  - Passport / ID
  - Hotel reservation confirmations
  - Car rental confirmation (for North Shore road trip)
  - Travel insurance details
  - Credit cards / cash
  - Printed itinerary

MISCELLANEOUS
  - Reusable shopping bag (for Ala Moana Center)
  - Books / e-reader for relaxation days
  - Snacks for road trip
